outlooks.summary: SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS THE LOWER CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE LOWER MISSOURI AND MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEYS TODAY INTO TONIGHT.

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS SURROUNDING THE ENH RISK OVER PORTIONS OF THE UPPER AND MID MS VALLEYS... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE NRN HIGH PLAINS TO THE MID MS VALLEY... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER FAR SE OK AND THE ARKLATEX REGION...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH CO WILL CONTINUE EWD THROUGH THE CNTRL PLAINS AND INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY TODAY. UPPER RIDGING WILL BE IN PLACE ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES REGION AT THE BEGINNING OF THE PERIOD WITH FLANKING UPPER TROUGHS. THIS OMEGA BLOCKING PATTERN WILL RESULT IN LITTLE PROGRESSION OF THE OVERALL UPPER PATTERN...WITH THE EXCEPTION OF SOME AMPLIFICATION OF THE UPPER RIDGE AS THE CNTRL PLAINS SHORTWAVE TROUGH APPROACHES. SURFACE PATTERN AT THE BEGINNING OF THE PERIOD IS EXPECTED TO BE SOMEWHAT ILL-DEFINED WITH THE MOST DISCERNIBLE SYNOPTIC BOUNDARY SEPARATING THE WARM AND MOIST AIRMASS OVER PLAINS FROM MORE CONTINENTAL AIR FARTHER N AND E. THIS BOUNDARY WILL LIKELY EXTEND FROM A LOW NEAR THE CNTRL NEB/SD BORDER ESEWD ACROSS NRN PORTIONS OF THE MS VALLEY INTO THE OH VALLEY. THIS SURFACE LOW IS EXPECTED TO DEEPEN AS IT CONTINUES NEWD...WITH THE WARM FRONT LIFTING NEWD AS WELL.

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS...MID/UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: SYNOPTIC BOUNDARY MENTIONED IN THE SYNOPSIS AS WELL AS REMNANT OUTFLOW AND/OR ANY MESOSCALE BOUNDARIES RESULTING FROM DIFFERENTIAL HEATING WILL ALL PLAY A ROLE IN STORM DEVELOPMENT...PERSISTENCE... AND SEVERITY ACROSS THE REGION TODAY. CONVECTION WILL BE ONGOING AT THE BEGINNING OF THE PERIOD AS THE ACTIVITY CURRENTLY OVER NEB CONTINUES ENEWD. MOST RECENTLY AVAILABLE GUIDANCE -- BOTH CONVECTION-ALLOWING AND DETERMINISTIC -- DOES NOT HAVE A GOOD HANDLE ON THE CONVECTION MOVING ACROSS NEB...WITH ALL OF THE GUIDANCE TOO SLOW WITH ITS EWD PROGRESSION. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT THIS CONVECTIVE COMPLEX WILL REACH THE MID MO VALLEY AROUND 12Z AND THEN CONTINUE NEWD INTO MN. CLOUD SHIELD ASSOCIATED WITH THIS CONVECTION WILL HELP TO REINFORCE THE WARM FRONT ALREADY IN PLACE WITH REMNANT OUTFLOW FARTHER W ACTING AS THE EFFECTIVE COLD FRONT. EVEN IF THE OUTFLOW WASHES OUT...THE ACTUAL COLD FRONT SHOULD PUSH EWD INTO THE REGION DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND ACT AS AN IMPETUS FOR CONVECTION. GIVEN THIS COMPLEX PATTERN...WHEN CONVECTION INITIATION OCCURS AND HOW CONVECTION ACTUALLY EVOLVES IS UNCERTAIN BUT SCATTERED TO WIDESPREAD TSTM ACTIVITY STILL APPEARS LIKELY. MOIST AIRMASS IS ALREADY IN PLA

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL SPREAD ACROSS THE REGION DURING THE AFTERNOON AS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVES THROUGH THE BASE OF THE UPPER LOW CENTERED OVER BRITISH COLUMBIA. DESPITE MEAGER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...DEEP BOUNDARY LAYER MIXING COUPLED WITH COOLING MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES WILL RESULT IN MODEST INSTABILITY AND ISOLATED TSTMS. GUSTY WINDS AND HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THE MORE PERSISTENT UPDRAFTS. FARTHER E -- I.E. NEAR THE MT/DAKOTAS BORDER -- ISOLATED STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE ON THE NW SIDE OF THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH THE CNTRL PLAINS.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF FAR SE OK AND THE ARKLATEX
sections.text: MCS CURRENTLY MOVING ACROSS OK MAY PROVIDE A LOW PROBABILITY RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND ISOLATED HAIL EARLY IN THE PERIOD ACROSS FAR SE OK AND NE TX. ADDITIONALLY...TRAILING OUTFLOW MAY PROVIDE THE IMPETUS FOR ADDITIONAL CONVECTION DURING THE AFTERNOON BUT CONFIDENCE IN LOCATION AND EVEN LOWER CONFIDENCE IN ACTUAL INITIATION PRECLUDES EXTENDING ANY PROBABILITIES FARTHER W. ..MOSIER/GLEASON.. 06/14/2016

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTH CENTRAL STATES THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. OTHER MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ARE FORECAST TO AFFECT SOUTHWEST OKLAHOMA INTO WEST-CENTRAL TEXAS.

sections.title: MIDWEST
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOP SHOWS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER WESTERN NEB TRACKING NORTHEASTWARD. THIS FEATURE WILL AFFECT THE NORTHERN PLAINS AND UPPER MIDWEST TODAY...AIDING IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS. A SURFACE LOW CURRENTLY ANALYZED OVER CENTRAL SD WILL TRACK NORTHWARD AS WELL...MOVING INTO SOUTHEAST ND AND WESTERN MN BY LATE AFTERNOON. MODEL GUIDANCE IS CONSISTENT IN SUGGESTING A NARROW CORRIDOR OF MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR OVER SOUTHWEST MN AND PARTS OF IA...WHERE DEWPOINTS WILL RISE INTO THE UPPER 60S AND SOME DAYTIME HEATING WILL OCCUR. BY MID AFTERNOON...THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT AND PREFRONTAL TROUGH/DRYLINE. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT SUPERCELL/BOWING STORM STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. IT APPEARS THERE IS A RISK OF A TORNADO OR TWO JUST EAST OF THE SURFACE LOW IN WESTERN MN WHERE ENHANCED LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND DEEP VORTICITY WILL BE PRESENT. OVERNIGHT CAM SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THAT STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP AS FAR SOUTH AS I-70 IN CENTRAL MO. FROM THERE SOUTHWARD INTO SOUTHERN MO/SOUTHEAST KS/NORTHERN OK...FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELL STORMS

sections.title: OK/TX
sections.text: A RATHER STRONG DRYLINE IS FORECAST TO ORGANIZE THIS AFTERNOON FROM SOUTHWEST OK INTO WEST-CENTRAL TX. SUBSTANTIAL DAYTIME HEATING AND LARGE CAPE VALUES ALONG THIS CORRIDOR ARE EXPECTED TO RESULT IN SCATTERED LATE AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORMS. THE ACTIVITY OVER SOUTHWEST OK AND WESTERN NORTH TX MAY BE SUPERCELLULAR... WITH MORE HIGH-BASED MULTICELL CONVECTION FARTHER SOUTH. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS.

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: HAVE ADDED A SMALL MARGINAL RISK AREA FOR PARTS OF NC/SC. THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM ALONG A SURFACE BOUNDARY THAT STRETCHES ACROSS THIS ZONE...WHERE MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2500 J/KG ARE EXPECTED LATER TODAY. SUFFICIENT WESTERLY UPPER LEVEL WINDS AND DEGREE OF INSTABILITY SUGGEST SOME RISK OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH THE STRONGEST CELLS. ..HART/LEITMAN.. 06/14/2016

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. OTHER MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ARE FORECAST TO AFFECT THE CENTRAL PLAINS...LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY AND THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM MT AND THE PLAINS TO THE MIDWEST...

sections.text: ...SUMMARY... SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. OTHER MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ARE FORECAST TO AFFECT THE CENTRAL PLAINS...LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY AND THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST SOUTHWARD TO EASTERN KS/WESTERN MO
sections.text: A WARM FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD SLOWLY NORTHWARD FROM IA/CENTRAL IL TOWARD SOUTHERN MN/NORTHERN IL...WITH A VERY MOIST AND WEAKLY CAPPED/INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR AHEAD OF AN EASTWARD-MOVING PACIFIC FRONT. WHILE CLOUD COVER LINGERS...INCREASING SURFACE-BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD INITIALLY OCCUR THROUGH EARLY/MID-AFTERNOON FROM EASTERN NEB INTO SOUTHERN MN AND WESTERN/NORTHERN IA. MODESTLY STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SOME SUPERCELLS AND ORGANIZED LINE SEGMENTS AS STORMS SPREAD EASTWARD THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EVENING ACROSS IA/TOWARD SOUTHEAST MN. WHILE SOME QUESTIONS EXIST REGARDING THE DEGREE OF DESTABILIZATION NEAR THE WARM FRONT...A TORNADO RISK MAY EXIST. THE LIKELIHOOD AND EXTENT OF DEEP CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING BECOMES MORE UNCERTAIN PROGRESSIVELY SOUTHWARD ACROSS KS/MO. RELATED TO AN OVERNIGHT/EARLY MORNING MCS ACROSS OK...SOME CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING /REFERENCE 12Z SOUNDINGS FROM NORMAN AND LAMONT OK/ AND RELATED BOUNDARY-LAYER DRYING HAS OCCURRED FROM OK INTO SOUTH-CENTRAL KS AS OF MID/LATE MORNING. AT THE VERY LEAST...AMPLE RESIDUAL LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS WESTERN MO AND EASTERN KS

sections.title: OK/TX
sections.text: A RATHER STRONG DRYLINE IS FORECAST FROM SOUTHWEST OK SOUTHWESTWARD INTO WEST-CENTRAL/SOUTHWEST TX...WITH DECAYING OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING AN ADDITIONAL FACTOR ACROSS SOUTHWEST OK AND WESTERN NORTH TX. SUBSTANTIAL DAYTIME HEATING AND LARGE CAPE VALUES ALONG THIS CORRIDOR SHOULD RESULT IN WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS BY LATE AFTERNOON. THE ACTIVITY OVER SOUTHWEST OK AND WESTERN NORTH TX MAY BE SUPERCELLULAR GIVEN MODESTLY STRONGER WESTERLIES...WITH MORE HIGH-BASED MULTICELL CONVECTION FARTHER SOUTH. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARDS BEFORE CONVECTION TENDS TO WEAKEN BY LATE EVENING.

SUFFICIENT WESTERLY UPPER LEVEL WINDS AND DEGREE OF INSTABILITY SUGGEST SOME RISK OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH THE STRONGEST CELLS. ..GUYER/ROGERS.. 06/14/2016

outlooks.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL PERSIST OVER THE UPPER MIDWEST THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. OTHER MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE OVER A PORTION OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY REGION
sections.text: A FEW ORGANIZED STORMS WITHIN A MORE GENERAL AREA OF SCATTERED MULTICELLS WILL PERSIST IN THIS REGION INTO THE EARLY EVENING. POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR STORMS TO EVOLVE INTO MINI SUPERCELLS AS THEY CROSS THE WARM FRONT WHERE LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE BACKED TO ELY RESULTING IN SUFFICIENT 0-1 KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITY FOR LOW-LEVEL MESOCYCLONES AND A FEW BRIEF TORNADOES. OTHERWISE THE STRONGER STORMS MAY PRODUCE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND A FEW INSTANCES OF HAIL.

sections.title: CNTRL AND SRN PLAINS AREA
sections.text: WILL MAINTAIN SLIGHT RISK IN THESE AREAS AT LEAST UNTIL THE 01Z UPDATE BUT THREAT REMAINS HIGHLY CONDITIONAL. CONFIDENCE IN STORM INITIATION IS NOT PARTICULARLY HIGH DUE TO WEAK FORCING ALONG CONVERGENT BOUNDARIES AND DRYING/SUBSIDENCE ALOFT. ..DIAL.. 06/14/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT TUE JUN 14 2016/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS HAVE BEGUN TO INCREASE ACROSS PORTIONS OF ERN NEB AND IA OVER THE PAST HALF HOUR...WITH CONTINUED INCREASES IN BOTH COVERAGE AND INTENSITY EXPECTED INTO EARLY AFTERNOON. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SURFACE ANALYSIS DEPICTS A SURFACE LOW OVER SERN SD ATTM...WITH A COOL FRONT EXTENDING SSWWD ACROSS ERN NEB AND INTO KS...WHILE A WARM FRONT -- BEING RETARDED IN NWD ADVANCE BY ONGOING CLOUDS/PRECIPITATION -- LYING ESEWD ACROSS THE MN/IA BORDER AREA AND INTO NRN IL. WITHIN THE VERY MOIST /LOW 70S DEWPOINTS/ WARM SECTOR...HEATING THROUGH SCATTERED CLOUDS IS ALLOWING STEADY DESTABILIZATION TO OCCUR...WITH 1000 TO 2000 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE NOW WIDESPREAD PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSES. VISIBLE SATELLITE HAS REVEALED GRADUAL MATURATION OF THE CU FIELD ACROSS IA...BUT RECENTLY MORE VIGOROUS TCU/CB DEVELOPMENT HAS INITIATED ALONG THE COOL FRONT FROM NEAR THE LOW OVER SERN SD SWD ACROSS ERN NEB. THE LOCATION AND TIMING OF THIS DEVELOPMENT IS CONSISTENT WITH AN ENSEMBLE OF CAM GUIDANCE -- WITH THIS GUIDANCE SUGGESTIVE OF A STEADY INCREASE IN STORMS INVOF BOTH THE COOL AND WARM FRONTS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AREA VWPS INDICATE GRADUALLY VEERING/INCREASING FLOW WITH HEIGHT FROM THE BOUNDARY LAYER THROUGH MID LEVELS...SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED/ROTATING UPDRAFTS. INITIAL STORMS OVER ERN IA APPEAR TO BE DEVELOPING LINEARLY...WITH HAIL AND WIND LIKELY TO BE THE MAIN SEVERE RISKS IN THIS AREA. GREATER TORNADO RISK WOULD LIKELY EXIST N/NE OF THIS REGION NEARER THE WARM FRONT AND SURFACE LOW -- PARTICULARLY IF STORMS CAN MAINTAIN MORE CELLULAR STRUCTURE. GIVEN CURRENT DEVELOPMENT...WW MAY BE REQUIRED WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND SMALL HAIL WILL ACCOMPANY DEVELOPING TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF SC AND SRN NC THIS AFTERNOON. A WW IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT IS EXPECTED TO STALL JUST N OF THE NC-SC BORDER THIS AFTERNOON. RELATIVELY RICHER MOISTURE POSITIONED TO THE W /PER 12Z SOUNDINGS/ IS SPREADING EWD ACROSS THE CAROLINAS...ALONG THE NRN PERIPHERY OF A MIDLEVEL ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OFF THE FL ATLANTIC COAST. WITH SFC TEMPERATURES ALREADY IN THE UPPER 80S TO LOWER 90S F...AND MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 2500 J/KG...TSTM COVERAGE WILL INCREASE OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS ALONG/S OF THE STALLING FRONT. MODEST WLY FLOW ALOFT /I.E. AROUND 20 KT AT 500 MB/ WILL SUPPORT A FEW WEAKLY ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS...WITH A PRIMARY THREAT OF ISOLATED STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR DOWNBURST WINDS. SMALL HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE...BUT WARM TEMPERATURES ALOFT WILL BE A LIMITING FACTOR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DEVELOPING THUNDERSTORMS MAY CAUSE A FEW STRONG/SEVERE WIND GUSTS THIS AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...WATCH ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST REGIONAL RADAR MOSAIC DEPICTS A BROKEN BAND OF MORE VIGOROUS CONVECTION ORGANIZING ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL MT THIS AFTERNOON. AS A MID/UPPER-LEVEL JET CONTINUES TO SPREAD ACROSS THE REGION...CONVECTION SHOULD FURTHER BLOSSOM ACROSS WESTERN/CENTRAL MT. AS STORMS SPREAD EAST...THEY WILL GRADUALLY ENCOUNTER A SLIGHTLY MORE UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...WHERE SFC TEMPS HAVE RISEN INTO THE 70S AND DEW POINTS INTO THE MID 40S TO LOWER 50S. A WELL-MIXED /INVERTED-V/ BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS THIS REGION WILL ENHANCE DOWNDRAFT POTENTIAL...WITH STRONGER CORES CAPABLE OF A FEW SEVERE GUSTS. THIS POTENTIAL WILL BE FURTHER AUGMENTED BY VIGOROUS SOUTHWESTERLY FLOW IN THE CLOUD-BEARING LAYER /AROUND 40-50 KTS/...WHICH IS WITNESSED IN RECENT KTFX VWP DATA. NONETHELESS...A LACK OF GREATER MOISTURE /AND RELATED BUOYANCY/ SHOULD KEEP THE THREAT ISOLATED ENOUGH TO PRECLUDE WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE TO MOVE ACROSS MAINLY WRN PORTIONS OF WW 254.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP REVEALS A SEMI-ORGANIZED BAND OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS MOVING ACROSS FAR SWRN MN AND WRN PORTIONS OF IA...I.E. NRN AND WRN PORTIONS OF WW 254 AND PARTS OF NEWLY ISSUED/ADJACENT WW 255 OVER SRN MN. THE STORMS ARE ONGOING NEAR/AHEAD OF AN EWD-MOVING COOL FRONT...AND ALONG/S OF A WARM FRONT EXTENDING ENEWD ACROSS SRN MN/NERN IA AND INTO NRN IL. WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR...A MOIST/MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS PERSISTS...WHICH WILL FUEL A CONTINUATION -- AND POSSIBLE INCREASE -- IN STORMS OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...WITH A GRADUAL EWD CONVECTIVE ADVANCE EXPECTED. WHILE SHEAR REMAINS SOMEWHAT LIMITED -- PARTICULARLY WITH SWD EXTENT ACROSS IA AWAY FROM THE BACKED LOW-LEVEL FLOW NEARER THE WARM FRONT...LOCAL SEVERE RISK REMAINS OVER VALID PORTIONS OF THE WW. ..GOSS.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE RISK MAY EVOLVE ACROSS SWRN SD/NRN NEB AND VICINITY AS STORMS SPREAD EWD. WW IS NOT EXPECTED ATTM DUE TO EXPECTATION THAT STORMS WILL REMAIN ISOLATED AND MARGINALLY SEVERE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS CU INCREASING ACROSS THE BLACK HILLS VICINITY OF SWRN SD...WITH A FEW CB NOW OCCURRING INTO THE NRN NEB VICINITY. STRONG HEATING CONTINUING TO THE SW OF DENSE CLOUD COVER ASSOCIATED WITH ONGOING CONVECTION OVER ND/NRN SD ALONG WITH LOW 60S DEWPOINTS E OF THE BLACK HILLS IS YIELDING MIXED-LAYER CAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS. WHILE A CLEAR SURFACE FOCUS FOR ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IS NOT EVIDENT IN SURFACE DATA...CONTINUED HEATING INVOF THE BLACK HILLS AND POSSIBLE PRESENCE OF A SUBTLE VORT MAX CROSSING WRN SD/NWRN NEB ATTM PER WV IMAGERY APPEARS TO BE SUPPORTING THE ONGOING/ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT. GIVEN MID-LEVEL WLYS ON THE ORDER OF 25 KT...SOME FURTHER UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION IS POSSIBLE...ALONG WITH ASSOCIATED/LOW-END SEVERE RISK. ATTM HOWEVER...WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED DUE TO WHAT APPEARS LIKELY TO REMAIN ONLY ISOLATED CONVECTIVE COVERAGE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS INCREASING ACROSS/SPREADING INTO AREAS OF SERN MN/ERN IA AND VICINITY E OF WW 254 AND 255 WILL LIKELY REQUIRE WW ISSUANCE SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP SHOWS AND BAND OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS MOVING ACROSS SWRN AND S CENTRAL MN/WRN IA ATTM...WHERE LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES HAVE BEEN REPORTED. THE STORMS ARE MOVING RATHER QUICKLY EWD...AND MAY BEGIN TO SPREAD E OF THE ONGOING WATCH AREAS IN THE NEXT 60 TO 90 MINUTES. MEANWHILE...STORMS ONGOING NEAR THE WARM FRONT INVOF THE UPPER MS VALLEY AREA MAY ALSO INCREASE A BIT FURTHER IN INTENSITY...BECOMING SEVERE AS THEY INGEST MODERATELY UNSTABLE /1500 TO 2000 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE/ AIR. WITH LOW-LEVEL SELY FLOW ACROSS THE AREA PROVIDING ENHANCED SHEAR...THE EVOLVING SEVERE RISK E OF THE CURRENT WATCHES SEEMS TO WARRANT STRONG CONSIDERATION FOR WW ISSUANCE SHORTLY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR IN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO ACROSS PORTIONS OF WRN N TX AND ADJACENT SRN OK IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. WW MAY BE REQUIRED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE TRENDS SHOW AN INCREASE IN CU DEVELOPMENT IN THE AMA-PVW-LBB VICINITY...NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF A DRYLINE AND A WEAK/REMNANT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW LAID DOWN BY EARLIER OK CONVECTION. A SLIGHT INCREASE IN THE CU FIELD IS ALSO NOTED SE OF CDS...LIKELY INVOF THE OUTFLOW ITSELF. SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 70S AND CONTINUED HEATING THROUGH THE LOW 90S ARE COMBINING WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES TO YIELD STRONG DESTABILIZATION...WITH MIXED-LAYER CAPE VALUES NOW INTO THE 3000 TO 4000 J/KG RANGE ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. THOUGH NOT AS CONSISTENT IN EARLIER RUNS THIS MORNING...VARIOUS VERSIONS OF HRRR OUTPUT ARE CONSISTENTLY -- FOR THE PAST SEVERAL RUNS -- HINTING AT A CLUSTER OF STORMS DEVELOPING ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. AS SUCH...CONFIDENCE IS INCREASING THAT STORMS WILL DEVELOP...AND WITH THE SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER FLOW ALOFT RESIDING ATOP THIS AREA /SUFFICIENT FOR MID-LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION/...RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH A FEW STORMS. WHILE COVERAGE MAY REMAIN ISOLATED...RISK MAY BECOME SUFFICIENT FOR WW CONSIDERATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTERS OF STRONG TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO CROSS PORTIONS OF THE AREA THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON...AND AN ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUST OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF STRONG TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED INVOF THE EDGE OF A PLUME OF RICHER BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE SPREADING EWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE OH AND TN VALLEY REGION. LOCALIZED INSTANCES OF UPSCALE GROWTH OF CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY HAVE RESULTED IN STRONGER COLD POOLS EVOLVING E OF LOUISVILLE INTO PARTS OF CNTRL KY. A NARROW CORRIDOR OF MODERATE INSTABILITY E OF THE ONGOING ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY MAINTAIN STRONG TSTM POTENTIAL DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS WITH AN ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUST OR TWO POSSIBLE -- AIDED BY WATER LOADING GIVEN PW AROUND 1.75 INCHES. FOLLOWING PREFERENTIAL CELL DEVELOPMENT/PROPAGATION EWD IN THE UNSTABLE AIR...THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY WEAKEN IN A FEW HOURS AS IT ENCOUNTERS THE EDGE OF NOTABLY LOWER THETA-E...FROM SW OF THE COVINGTON KY AREA TO LONDON KY. WEAK DEEP SHEAR WILL PRECLUDE A MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR RISK FROM EVOLVING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SVR POTENTIAL WILL ACCOMPANY TSTMS SPREADING ACROSS PARTS OF NERN MT THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING HOURS. WHILE CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...WW ISSUANCE IS PRESENTLY UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FORWARD-PROPAGATING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER BETWEEN HAVRE AND LEWISTOWN WILL CONTINUE SPREADING EWD/NEWD ACROSS PARTS OF NERN MT. THIS ACTIVITY LIES WITHIN THE PERIPHERY OF ASCENT ACCOMPANYING A MID-LEVEL SHORTWAVE IMPULSE GLANCING THE AREA...WHICH IS ORBITING THE ERN SEMI-CIRCLE OF A DEEP CYCLONE ANCHORED OVER SWRN BRITISH COLUMBIA PER WATER VAPOR LOOPS. INFLOW FOR THE ONGOING CONVECTION REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE...AS MIDDLE 50S DEWPOINTS ARE SAMPLED ACROSS NERN MT PER SFC OBS -- WHICH ARE RELATIVELY MOIST FOR THESE ELEVATIONS. WITH STEEP TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES IN PLACE...COUPLED WITH 30-45 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...MAINTAINED ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WITH LOCALLY/MARGINALLY SVR WIND/HAIL MAY OCCUR. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE ONLY GLANCING INFLUENCE OF STRONGER ASCENT...AND GIVEN THE TENDENCY FOR PREFERENTIAL CELL DEVELOPMENT/PROPAGATION TO CARRY THE CONVECTION INTO PROGRESSIVELY WEAKER DEEP SHEAR EWD IN MT...ANY SVR RISK SHOULD BE ISOLATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS MAINLY SERN PORTIONS OF WW 255 IN S-CNTRL/SERN MN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ARCING BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS EXTENDS ACROSS FAR NERN SD INTO PARTS OF CNTRL/SRN MN AS OF 2215Z. A SFC WARM FRONT IS ANALYZED FROM CNTRL MN INTO SWRN WI...AND IT SHOULD SHIFT ONLY SLOWLY NWD/EWD WITH TIME. RECENT RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST CONVECTION IS BECOMING QUICKLY ELEVATED ABOVE THE WARM FRONT AND WEAKENING FROM FAR NERN SD INTO MUCH OF CNTRL MN. A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS EXTENDING FROM RICE SWD TO FREEBORN COUNTY MN SHOULD CONTINUE EWD AND POSE MAINLY A DAMAGING WIND THREAT AS IT MOVES INTO WW 256. HOWEVER... BACKED SELY SFC WINDS AND EFFECTIVE SRH OF 100-200 M2/S2 SHOULD ALLOW FOR EMBEDDED CIRCULATIONS WITHIN THE LINE TO POSE AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT IN THE SHORT TERM. COUNTIES CAN CONTINUE TO BE CLEARED FROM WW 255 FROM SW TO NE AS THE ARC OF THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUES NWD/EWD. FINALLY...A SMALL LOCAL EXTENSION IN AREA MIGHT BE NEEDED INTO FAR W-CNTRL WI TO THE E OF THE TWIN CITIES DEPENDING ON CONVECTIVE TRENDS IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. ..GLEASON.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A WW WILL BE COORDINATED SHORTLY FOR PORTIONS OF THE TX S PLAINS...WRN NORTH TX...AND PERHAPS ADJACENT FAR SWRN OK. VERY ISOLATED SVR TSTMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...DMGG WINDS...AND THE RISK FOR A TORNADO MAY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE AND RADAR LOOPS SUGGEST REPEATED CONVECTIVE ATTEMPTS AND RELATED MODULATIONS TO THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES HAVE FOSTERED DEVELOPMENT OF MORE VIGOROUS CONVECTION NEAR A TRIPLE POINT ANALYZED IN MOTLEY COUNTY TX. TOWERING CUMULUS TRAILING SWWD ALONG THE DRYLINE MAY ALSO EVOLVE INTO DEEPER CONVECTION DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS -- EMANATING FROM THE EDGE OF NEAR-DRY-ADIABATIC LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. THE AIR MASS IN PROXIMITY TO/AND S OF A RESIDUAL/DIFFUSE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ANALYZED FROM THE TRIPLE POINT ENEWD INTO S-CNTRL OK IS STRONGLY TO EXTREMELY UNSTABLE -- WITH MLCAPE AROUND 3000-4500 J/KG AIDED BY LOWER/MIDDLE 70S SFC DEWPOINTS LYING BENEATH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. AS SUCH...WITH INCREASING CONFIDENCE THAT SUSTAINED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS UNDERWAY...AND GIVEN 30-45 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL -- PERHAPS REACHING 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER -- AND SVR WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE. CONVECTION MAY TEND TO FAVOR THE LOWER-SRH ENVIRONMENT NEAR AND S OF THE BOUNDARY OWING TO AN OVERALL DEARTH OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT...LIMITING THE OVERALL TORNADO RISK. HOWEVER...WITH MODEST NOCTURNAL INCREASES IN SRH OWING TO INITIAL BOUNDARY-LAYER DECOUPLING WITHIN A FEW HOURS -- AMIDST THE MOIST ENVIRONMENT FAVORING SLOW GAINS IN MLCINH -- SOME TORNADO RISK COULD INCREASE IF A DISCRETE SUPERCELL MODE WERE TO BE MAINTAINED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR SOME INCREASE IN THE SVR TSTM POTENTIAL...WITH ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED SVR WIND/HAIL POSSIBLE THIS EVENING. WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED SHALLOW CONVECTION IS BEGINNING TO DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF ERN KS WITHIN A ZONE OF WEAKLY CONFLUENT...LOW-LEVEL WSWLY/SWLY FLOW THAT MARKS THE ERN EDGE OF WARMER AIR SLOWLY ADVANCING EWD. THE AIR MASS ACROSS THE REGION IS MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE...AIDED BY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AMIDST DEWPOINTS FROM THE 60S TO AROUND 70F. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...FOLLOWING MAXIMIZED DEEPENING OF BOUNDARY-LAYER CIRCULATIONS. IF SUSTAINED CONVECTION WERE TO DEVELOP...ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED SVR WIND/HAIL COULD OCCUR PROVIDED AROUND 30-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. THIS MAY BE OF PARTICULAR CONCERN NEAR/NORTH OF INTERSTATE-70...WHERE THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF A MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE AND RELATED MODEST MID-LEVEL COOLING MAY ENCOURAGE TSTM DEVELOPMENT. HOWEVER...WATER VAPOR LOOPS SUGGEST ABUNDANT MID-LEVEL DRY AIR OVERSPREADING PARTICULARLY SRN PARTS OF THE REGION...WHICH COULD INDICATE HOSTILE MID-LEVEL THERMODYNAMIC CONDITIONS FOR SUSTAINED TSTM DEVELOPMENT AMIDST MODEST LOW-LEVEL ASCENT. NEVERTHELESS... CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR SOME INCREASE IN THE SVR RISK. IF A MORE CONCENTRATED AREA OF SVR TSTM DEVELOPMENT WERE TO BECOME APPARENT...WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY ACROSS PARTS OF THE AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MAINLY A DAMAGING WIND THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW 256. AN ISOLATED TORNADO ALSO REMAINS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR IMAGERY AS OF 2320Z DEPICTS A LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MOVING EWD ACROSS SERN MN AND NERN IA. DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE THE MAIN THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY AS IT MOVES EWD INTO WRN WI. SOME STRONGER CORES HAVE BEEN NOTED IN CNTRL IA MOVING INTO WRN PORTIONS OF WW 256...AND THESE THUNDERSTORMS MAY HAVE A LARGE HAIL THREAT IN ADDITION TO SOME STRONG/GUSTY WINDS. A BROKEN BAND OF CONVECTION ACROSS E-CNTRL IA INTO NWRN IL IS SITUATED NEAR A SFC WARM FRONT...AND THIS ACTIVITY MAY POSE THE BEST CHANCE FOR AN ISOLATED TORNADO IN THE SHORT TERM GIVEN BACKED SELY SFC WINDS...SLIGHTLY MORE FAVORABLE STORM MODE...AND EFFECTIVE SRH GENERALLY AROUND 100-150 M2/S2. ALL OF THE AFOREMENTIONED ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO HAVE A SEVERE THREAT UNTIL IT REACHES/MOVES ACROSS THE WARM FRONT AND BECOMES ELEVATED. FINALLY...A LOCAL EXTENSION IN AREA SWD TO INCLUDE MORE OF SERN IA AND W-CNTRL IL MAY BE NEEDED TO ACCOUNT FOR ONGOING STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS NEAR DAVENPORT IA. ..GLEASON.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK CONTINUES IN WW 257.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: FOLLOWING MULTIPLE PHASES OF INGESTION OF INCIPIENT CONVECTION ON THE WRN FLANK OF AN ORGANIZING SUPERCELL OVER MOTLEY COUNTY TX -- EMANATING FROM ENHANCED MESOSCALE ASCENT NEAR A TRIPLE POINT ANALYZED 30 ENE PLAINVIEW TX -- PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT A CONSOLIDATED SUPERCELL IS EVOLVING SW OF PADUCAH TX. THIS CELL IS EXPECTED TO TRACK EWD/ESEWD DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...INTO/ACROSS SRN COTTLE -- AND PERHAPS FAR NRN KING COUNTY -- AND PERHAPS EVENTUALLY INTO FOARD/KNOX COUNTIES. NWD-STREAMING HORIZONTAL CONVECTIVE ROLLS IN ADVANCE OF THIS CELL -- EVIDENCE OF THE MOIST/SOMEWHAT SHEARED BOUNDARY LAYER -- SUGGEST THAT TSTM MAINTENANCE MAY CONTINUE. RECENT DEVELOPMENT OF CONVECTION IMMEDIATELY TO THE W MAY ALSO INTERACT WITH THE LEAD CELL. GIVEN SFC DEWPOINTS AROUND 70F SUPPORTING AROUND 4000 J/KG OF MLCAPE AMIDST 35-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...A CYCLIC SUPERCELL STRUCTURE MAY EVOLVE. MATURING CONVECTION NEAR CHILDRESS COULD ALSO EVOLVE IN A SIMILAR FASHION. A SLIGHT INCREASE IN 0.5-KM-AGL SLYS SAMPLED BY THE FDR VWP DURING THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS SUGGESTS THAT SOME INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL SRH MAY BE OCCURRING. DEVELOPMENT OF THE NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER SPEED MAX MAY CONTINUE TO FOSTER AN INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL SRH WHILE CELLS ORGANIZE. IF SUSTAINED SUPERCELLS WERE TO BE MAINTAINED IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...SOME TORNADO RISK MAY EXIST PROVIDED AMPLE BUOYANCY OFFERING STRONG STRETCHING OF VERTICAL VORTICITY. ..COHEN.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LARGE HAIL AND STRONG TO LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF WW 254.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR IMAGERY FROM KDMX SHOWS A WELL-DEFINED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLIER CONVECTION ACROSS NRN IA/SRN MN MOVING SWD ACROSS CNTRL IA WITH TIME. THIS BOUNDARY MAY ACT TO LIMIT STORM LONGEVITY AND INTENSITY TO LOCATIONS TO ITS S AND E...NAMELY S-CNTRL INTO SERN IA. THE AIRMASS ALONG AND S OF THE BOUNDARY REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE...WITH 23Z RAP MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATING MLCAPE RANGING FROM 1500-2000 J/KG. VEERED SWLY WINDS AT THE SFC AND ALOFT PER KDMX VWP SUGGEST ANY TORNADO THREAT SHOULD BE MINIMAL IN THE OPEN WARM SECTOR. BUT STRENGTHENING WINDS WITH HEIGHT WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SOME STORM ORGANIZATION OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS REMAINING THE MAIN THREATS. IF CONVECTION IS ABLE TO DEVELOP ACROSS S-CNTRL IA ALONG/AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT...THEN A SMALL LOCAL EXTENSION IN AREA MAY BE NEEDED FOR WW 254. ..GLEASON.. 06/15/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A RISK FOR STRONG TSTMS WILL AFFECT PORTIONS OF CNTRL IL INTO THE EVENING HOURS. WHILE CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...WW ISSUANCE IS PRESENTLY UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE ORIENTED NNW-SSE THROUGH PARTS OF CNTRL IL WILL BE A FOCUS FOR ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. CONVECTION GENERATING ON THE WARM SIDE OF THIS ZONE WILL TEND TO ADVANCE INTO THE MODESTLY COOLER AIR...AND SOME INCREASE IN THIS CONVECTION MAY OCCUR GIVEN ASCENT RELATED TO A GLANCING/SUBTLE MID-LEVEL PERTURBATION PER WATER VAPOR LOOPS. HOWEVER...AIR ON THE COOLER SIDE OF THIS BOUNDARY FEATURES SFC TEMPERATURES IN THE UPPER 70S AMIDST DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S SUPPORTING SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY FOR MAINTAINED CONVECTION AMIDST BACKED SFC WINDS. MODEST AMBIENT VERTICAL VORTICITY IN PROXIMITY TO THE FRONTAL ZONE...WITH SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL SRH ON ITS COOLER SIDE...MAY SUPPORT A BRIEF/WEAK TORNADO WITH SUSTAINED CONVECTION. ISOLATED STRONG TO PERHAPS DMGG WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT. HOWEVER...GIVEN POOR MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES/WEAK LOW-LEVEL FLOW/MODEST DEEP SHEAR SAMPLED BY THE 00Z ILX RAOB...THE SVR RISK IS PRESENTLY EXPECTED TO BE TOO MARGINAL FOR WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT IS DIMINISHING ACROSS WW 254 IN CNTRL IA. A LINGERING LOW-END STRONG/GUSTY WIND AND ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 256.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLIER CONVECTION ACROSS NRN IA AND SRN MN HAS SURGED SWD ACROSS SRN IA. THIS BOUNDARY HAS EFFECTIVELY UNDERCUT AN ONGOING CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IN THE VICINITY OF DES MOINES...AND LESSENED THE SEVERE RISK ACROSS REMAINING PARTS OF WW 254. IF CURRENT RADAR TRENDS CONTINUE...WW 254 WILL LIKELY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 02Z WITH NO REPLACEMENT WATCH. FURTHER E ACROSS ERN IA INTO WRN WI AND NWRN IL...A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS IS MOVING EWD AROUND 30-35 KT. THIS ACTIVITY HAS HAD SPORADIC STRONG WINDS/DAMAGE REPORTS OVER THE PAST HOUR. AS IT CONTINUES EWD INTO WRN WI...IT WILL ENCOUNTER A SFC WARM FRONT AND WILL LIKELY BECOME ELEVATED AS IT MOVES INTO CNTRL WI. PRIOR TO THIS OCCURRING...A LOCALIZED STRONG/GUSTY WIND THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE FOR THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...AND AN ISOLATED/BRIEF TORNADO REMAINS POSSIBLE MAINLY WITH CLUSTERS OF CELLS AHEAD OF THE LINE IN FAR ERN IA AND NWRN IL. EXPECTATIONS ARE FOR THE SEVERE THREAT TO DIMINISH AS THUNDERSTORMS MOVE FURTHER EWD INTO WI AND NRN IL...AND NO ADDITIONAL WATCHES ARE PLANNED DOWNSTREAM OF WW 256 INTO CNTRL/ERN WI OR N-CNTRL IL. ..GLEASON.. 06/15/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK IN WW 257 HAS BECOME CONFINED TO PARTS OF KING AND KNOX COUNTIES. THE SVR RISK ELSEWHERE IS NOW NIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SOLITARY SUPERCELL TSTM ENHANCED DURING THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE WILL CONTINUE TO BE ACCOMPANIED BY SVR HAIL POTENTIAL DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO AS IT TRACKS ACROSS PARTS OF KING AND KNOX COUNTIES IN WRN N TX. FOLLOWING INITIAL DECOUPLING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER...THE FDR VWP NOW SAMPLES AROUND 200 M2/S2 OF 0-1-KM SRH AS LOW-LEVEL SHEAR HAS INCREASED. HOWEVER...MLCINH HAS BEEN SLOW TO INCREASE OWING TO AMPLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE -- E.G. LOWEST-100-MB MEAN MIXING RATIO AROUND 17.5 G/KG PER A MODIFIED 00Z OUN RAOB. AS SUCH...SVR HAIL POTENTIAL...AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO...REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH AROUND 0400Z-0430Z. THEREAFTER...THE NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD BECOME INCREASINGLY HOSTILE FOR CONVECTIVE MAINTENANCE...GIVEN THE DEARTH OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT. THE SVR RISK ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE WW IS NOW NIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS CROSSING PARTS OF NRN IL OVERNIGHT MAY PRODUCE LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS. AN ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUST CANNOT BE RULED OUT...THOUGH WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FORWARD-PROPAGATING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER FROM STEPHENSON TO WHITESIDE COUNTIES HAS RECENTLY SHOWN SIGNS OF AN EWD SURGE/ACCELERATION...WITH FORWARD MOTION AROUND 30-35 KT. THIS ACTIVITY GREW UPSCALE FROM MERGING COLD POOLS IN SUCCESSION TO DIURNALLY ENHANCED CONVECTION UPSTREAM...AND WILL CONTINUE SPREADING EWD ACROSS NRN IL. WITH PW AROUND 1.75-2.00 INCHES IN THE MOIST AIR MASS ACROSS THE REGION PER GPS IMAGERY...WATER LOADING MAY CONTRIBUTE TO STRONG TSTM WIND GUSTS...AS AROUND 500-1000 J/KG OF MLCAPE LINGERS ACROSS THE AREA. CONTINUED NOCTURNAL COOLING AND RELATED GAINS IN MLCINH SHOULD TEND TO MINIMIZE THIS RISK AS CONVECTION SPREADS TOWARD THE CHICAGO METROPOLITAN AREA...WHERE IT WILL BEGIN TO INGEST DRIER BOUNDARY-LAYER AIR. WITH THE PRIMARY LARGE-SCALE ASCENT/LOW-LEVEL MASS RESPONSE FOCUSED N OF THE REGION...THE SVR RISK SHOULD BE MINIMAL OVERALL.
